description: This file contains unit tests for the LocationHandler class, verifying various scenarios such as permission checks, location retrieval behavior, and fallbacks using a FakeLocationDataSource. It defines test classes and methods to ensure correct handling of location permissions and data on Android.

classes.name: LocationHandlerTest
classes.description: A test class extending NodeHandlerRobolectricTest, containing various test cases for LocationHandler behavior.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_requiresLocationPermissionWhenNeitherFineNorCoarse
methods.description: Tests that the handler correctly reports permission requirement error when neither fine nor coarse location permissions are granted.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_requiresForegroundBeforeLocationPermission
methods.description: Tests that background location is unavailable if foreground permission isn't granted.

methods.name: hasFineLocationPermission_reflectsDataSource
methods.description: Checks that the permission status reflects the FakeLocationDataSource configuration.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_usesPreciseGpsFirstWhenFinePermissionAndPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Verifies that the handler uses GPS provider with precise location enabled when permissions and settings allow.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_fallsBackToBalancedWhenPreciseUnavailable
methods.description: Ensures fallback to balanced provider when precise GPS is unavailable.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_mapsTimeoutToLocationTimeout
methods.description: Verifies that a timeout in fetching location maps to a LOCATION_TIMEOUT error.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_mapsOtherFailuresToLocationUnavailable
methods.description: Checks that other exceptions are mapped to LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE errors.
